title: RAGferee: Building Contextual Reward Models for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Andrei C. Coman; Ionut-Teodor Sorodoc; Leonardo F. R. Ribeiro; Bill Byrne; James Henderson; Adrià de Gispert
why_relevant: Trains contextual reward models that judge RAG responses on faithfulness, refusal when context is insufficient, and groundedness—relevant to calibration/abstention and evaluating RAG reliability.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on reward modeling for RAG judging rather than directly defending against noisy/adversarial evidence.
